page.layout: One manuscript page, right-hand leaf, filled with pen flourishes, sketches and scribbled notes across the whole sheet; no printed text block. Small fragments of writing on the left edge belong to the facing page.
page.notes: This is a handwritten manuscript page, not a printed one. It consists mainly of pen drawings and decorative flourishes: a cross-like ornament of linked loops at upper right, a second such ornament at middle right, a musical staff with notes at the bottom, and wavy scribbled shapes throughout. Legible handwriting is limited to a few fragments: "ruce" and "min" near the top; "mens" in the upper middle ("...ntes" / "mente" style strokes, uncertain); "ad" with "Tim" and "13.3." in the left margin area; "Mu" and "uiu" mid-page; a word resembling "Halten" or "Holzen" near the lower right; and a few short marks ("mw", "ort"). None of these can be read with certainty, so they are not transcribed. No printed text, running head, page number or catchword is present. The left edge shows part of the adjacent page, which is not transcribed.
